subject: blueprintSpitfire
pitch:
Category: Vehicle.
Subject: Spitfire fighter plane.
Style: cyanotype blueprint.

requests.what: Blueprint annotation-style propeller hub cap and four broad wooden-looking propeller blades in PALE_CYAN, with DARK_CYAN root collars and tiny cyan fasteners.
Large RAF-style cyanotype roundel on the upper surface: concentric circles in PALE_CYAN, MID_CYAN and DARK_CYAN, kept flat and clean inside the wing.
Matching RAF-style cyanotype roundel on the right upper wing, with three crisp concentric rings and a small central dot.
A bold vintage fuselage identification code, 'C-17', in pale blueprint lettering on the side behind the cockpit, with a thin DARK_CYAN rectangular backing plate.
Raised canopy framing: three slim cyan rails over the dark blue canopy, one longitudinal spine and two transverse hoops, all following the canopy curve.
Small dorsal radio antenna behind the canopy: a tapered DARK_CYAN mast with a short forward-leaning cyan aerial wire and a tiny spherical tip.
Six short rectangular exhaust stacks on the left side of the engine cowling, alternating MID_CYAN and DARK_CYAN, aimed slightly forward.
Cyanotype checker stripe near the top of the vertical tail, made from six small alternating PALE_CYAN and DARK_CYAN rectangular tiles.
Two inset landing-light bezels in the wing leading edges, pale cyan discs with DARK_CYAN rims, one on each wing near the roots.
Add fine cyanotype blueprint panel lines, spar seams and subtle construction station marks across both main wings; preserve the clean roundel area.
Paint thin pale cyan longitudinal blueprint guide lines, access-panel seams and evenly spaced rivet rows over the fuselage, leaving the code area uncluttered.
Add sparse cyanotype contour lines and hinge seams to the tail fin and rudder, with a darker shaded rudder edge.
